definitions.explanation: The fee or expense for textbooks, workbooks, and other materials used in educational courses or training programs.

examples.japanese: {教材費|きょうざいひ}は{別途|べっと}かかります。
examples.english: Teaching material costs are charged separately.

examples.japanese: {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}には{教材費|きょうざいひ}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The tuition includes the cost of materials.

examples.japanese: {年間|ねんかん}の{教材費|きょうざいひ}が{高|たか}くて、{保護者|ほごしゃ}から{不満|ふまん}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Complaints arose from parents because the annual cost of teaching materials was high.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly appears in school and course fee breakdowns. Often listed alongside tuition (授業料) and other fees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教材費|きょうざいひ}{込|こ}み (including materials cost)
- {教材費|きょうざいひ}{別|べつ} (materials cost separate)
- {年間|ねんかん}{教材費|きょうざいひ} (annual materials cost)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}: tuition — the fee for the classes themselves
- {教材|きょうざい}: teaching materials — the materials without reference to cost
